prompt: Wide from the top tier of a huge British football stadium: the pitch and the running track are covered edge to edge in tents and camp beds, people queueing at portable water tanks along the touchline, the giant floodlights off, the stands empty and grey, smoke from cooking stoves hanging under the roof. Winter dusk in a near-future Britain, cold blue-grey light, the only warm colour the small orange fires of braziers and camping stoves; photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, deep shadows that stay dark, no lens flare, no bloom, no teal-orange grade. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no signs, banners, logos, number plates or screen text. No children.
